comment: Company pre-screen eval: companies that must skip (staffing/consultancy, wrong geography, below-floor outsourcing), companies that must sweep, and one unknown that must route to maybe. Run: TYPESAFE_API_KEY=... node evals/run-company-screen.mjs

identity.headline: Staff Software Engineer · AI agent platforms, MCP, agentic systems · React/TypeScript

cases.context: Gusto is a US-based payroll and HR platform. All engineering roles are located in the United States (San Francisco, Denver, New York) and require US work authorization. No international offices.
We provide offshore software development teams from India on a staff-augmentation model. Engineers are placed with US clients at $18-25 per hour. Body-shopping contracts, 6-month renewable.
Notion builds a productivity and AI workspace product. Engineering offices in San Francisco, New York, Dublin, Hyderabad and Bengaluru. Hires senior engineers in India.
Qualcomm designs chips and platforms; it also runs large software and GenAI platform teams in Hyderabad, India.
